title: Springfield, APSU partnership maps future through GIS
summary: APSU GIS student teams partnered with Springfield to map water and wastewater infrastructure, accelerating data collection and improving operational planning for public utilities.

title: Science on Tap to explore the myths, mysteries and manhunts of mapping and GIS
summary: Dr. Mike Wilson highlighted GIS history and real-world APSU response work, including support for manhunts, missing-person efforts, and disaster response operations.

title: APSU GIS experts rush to aid storm-ravaged community
summary: Following major storms, APSU GIS personnel delivered near real-time damage mapping and dashboards that helped emergency managers prioritize aid and speed federal disaster response.

title: Austin Peay’s GIS Center partners with Meharry on $750K NASA grant for drones
summary: A three-year NASA-funded collaboration advances modular drone systems for emergency response and healthcare applications while expanding student workforce training opportunities.

title: APSU GIS Center Teams Up with Vanderbilt for Cutting-Edge LiDAR Traffic Study
summary: APSU GIS Center joined Vanderbilt and city partners to deploy LiDAR-based traffic analysis, supporting safer intersection planning and data-informed transportation decisions.

title: County parks, APSU work together to blaze better trail at Rotary Park
summary: APSU GIS collaboration with Montgomery County Parks supported a new GPS-accurate Rotary Park trail map and marker system to improve wayfinding and emergency location access.

title: APSU GIS Center student creates 3D-printed tactile campus map for students with low, no vision
summary: An APSU GIS student created a large-format tactile campus map with braille features, expanding campus accessibility and independent navigation for low- and no-vision students.
